info.title: Lowdown API
info.description: Lowdown records two kinds of data, kept separate: (1) interactions that agents report after using a tool or service, and (2) Lowdown Scanner observations of MCP Registry servers — a time-series record of the gap between what the official MCP Registry declares and what is actually observed. It records what changed and when; it does not score, grade, or rank servers. Public dataset and daily report: https://github.com/PetShopBros/lowdown-data For records of many servers, use the daily dataset at https://github.com/PetShopBros/lowdown-data (CC BY 4.0) instead of calling the lookup once per server; each lookup response carries a Link header to it.

get.summary: Get the Registry declaration, Scanner observations, and reported interactions for a target
get.description: Returns what Lowdown has recorded about a target, in this order: (1) `registry`: what the official MCP Registry declares for it, as recorded by Lowdown since 2026-10-19, with changes in the last 30 days; (2) `scanner`: what Lowdown Scanner observed (initialize + tools/list only), including one entry per day for the last 30 days, days without an observation and why, and the observed tool names; (3) interactions reported by agents. These are facts with their sources, not scores. Short names resolve when they match one target; otherwise candidate names are returned.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Identifier of the target: an MCP Registry name with the mcp: prefix, e.g. 'mcp:ai.agent-bev/bev-door' (the '/' may be sent as is or as %2F), a short name such as 'bev-door', an npm or PyPI package with the npm: or pypi: prefix, e.g. 'npm:@scope/name' or 'pypi:package-name' (answers with the Registry entries that declare it; several entries are returned as registry_candidates, none is picked; PyPI names match after PEP 503 normalization), or another id such as 'agent:some-agent-id'. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; other characters are used as given.

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.description: Limit interaction figures to one task type. Scanner data is not returned for task-filtered requests.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Optional referral tag used to measure where lookups come from.

resolved_target.description: Registry name the lookup resolved to, with the mcp: prefix.

message.description: One factual sentence: whether a Registry record, Scanner observations, and reported interactions exist, and, for observed servers, when tool definitions last changed. When a declared npm package is marked deprecated on its latest version, a declared PyPI package's latest version is yanked or the project is archived, quarantined or deprecated, or npm or PyPI answers 404 for it (for PyPI, saying whether the project exists without releases or does not exist), that fact comes first. If the target contains a literal escape sequence such as \n, a final sentence says so; the target is not changed.

registry.description: Declared facts from the official MCP Registry as recorded by Lowdown (records kept since 2026-10-19). `listed: false` with a note when no record matches.

listed.description: true when the entry is in the Registry as of the latest record.

removed_at.description: When Lowdown recorded the entry as gone from the Registry list.

recorded_since_baseline.description: true for entries already present in Lowdown's first Registry snapshot (2026-10-19); first_recorded_at is then not when the entry first appeared in the Registry.

changes_30d.description: Registry changes detected in the last 30 days, newest first (max 20). old/new are given for version and status changes.

registry_candidates.description: Returned instead of `registry` when a short name matches several Registry names, or when several Registry entries declare the npm or PyPI package given as npm:<name> or pypi:<name> (up to 50, none is picked).

packages.description: Packages declared by the Registry entry (or the package given as npm:<name> or pypi:<name>), in declaration order, up to 10. Only npm and PyPI packages are checked.

registry.description: Package registry type as declared (npm, pypi, oci, nuget, mcpb, cargo).

declared_version.description: Version declared in the Registry. Absent for npm: and pypi: lookups that return several candidates.

npm.description: npm status recorded daily by Lowdown from npm's public registry metadata. Present for npm packages; null when the declared name is not a valid npm name.

status.description: not_found only when npm answered HTTP 404. Network errors, 429 and 5xx do not change the recorded status. not_checked: not yet in Lowdown's npm records.

latest.description: Version npm tags as latest (status found).

latest_deprecated.description: Whether the version npm tags as latest is marked deprecated. It says nothing about other versions.

modified.description: npm's modified time for the package document.

declared_is_latest.description: Whether the version declared in the Registry equals npm's latest. Absent for npm: lookups.

not_found_since.description: status not_found only: the UTC day npm started answering 404 after the package had been available, or "first_check" when it has answered 404 since Lowdown's first check.

recent_events.description: Up to 5 changes in the last 30 days, newest first.

last_seen_latest.description: not_found events: the latest version recorded before the 404.

pypi.description: PyPI status recorded daily by Lowdown from PyPI's public JSON and Index APIs. Present for pypi packages; null when the declared name is not a valid PyPI project name. Package code is not run; descriptions, yank reasons and vulnerability data are not read.

status.description: not_found only when PyPI's JSON API answered HTTP 404. Network errors, 429 and 5xx do not change the recorded status. not_checked: not yet in Lowdown's PyPI records.

latest.description: Version PyPI lists as latest (status found).

latest_yanked.description: Whether that latest version is yanked. It says nothing about other versions.

latest_uploaded.description: Latest upload time of that version's files.

project_status.description: PEP 792 project status: active, archived, quarantined or deprecated. null when not known or when PyPI has no project of this name.

declared_is_latest.description: Whether the version declared in the Registry equals PyPI's latest. Absent when the package was given as pypi:<name>.

not_found_since.description: status not_found only: the UTC day PyPI started answering 404 after the project had been available, or "first_check" when it has answered 404 since Lowdown's first check.

not_found_kind.description: status not_found only, from PyPI's Index API: no_releases = PyPI lists the project but it has no release; no_project = PyPI has no project of this name. null when not known (for example, records made before 2026-10-24).

first_checked_at.description: First time Lowdown checked this project.

recent_events.description: Up to 5 changes in the last 30 days, newest first.

old.description: latest_changed: previous version. status_changed: previous project status.

new.description: latest_changed: new version. status_changed: new project status.

latest.description: restored: the latest version when it came back.

last_seen_latest.description: not_found: the latest version recorded before the 404.

packages_note.description: How the npm and PyPI values are recorded and what they do not mean.

scanner.description: Observations by Lowdown Scanner (initialize + tools/list only; no tool calls). Separate from interaction data; not included in success_rate. When the target is outside the Scanner's fixed sample of daily-observed MCP Registry entries (5,000 from 2026-10-19, 2,000 before), this block contains only `observed: false` and a note; absence of data says nothing about the target's status.

observed.description: false when no Scanner observation exists for this target.

reached_level.description: 0 = initialize failed, 1 = initialize ok, 2 = initialize + tools/list ok

in_sample.description: Whether the target is in a Scanner cohort.

first_observed_at.description: First observation of this target by Lowdown Scanner.

definition_changes.description: Changes in the server's tool definitions in Lowdown's daily observations of the last 30 days. Each day's observation is compared with the previous one from the same remote URL, using hashes of tool schemas, descriptions and names; description text is never returned. Facts only: no score or risk level.

pattern.description: `changes_on_most_days`: definitions changed on at least half of at least 4 compared days, so a single change is routine for this server.

observed_days.description: Days with a complete tools/list observation (reached_level 2).

compared_days.description: Days that could be compared with an earlier observation from the same remote.

change_days.description: Compared days on which a schema, description or tool name hash differed.

days_since_last_change.description: Days from last_change to the latest observed day.

stable_days_before_last_change.description: Days from the previous change (or the first observed day) to last_change.

events.description: Up to 5 most recent changes, newest first.

returned_to_earlier_definition.description: The new definition equals one observed earlier from the same remote.

remote_host.description: Present only when the server has several remotes.

daily_30d.description: One entry per UTC day with an observation in the last 30 days. When a target has several remotes, the entry with the highest reached_level is shown and `remotes` counts them.

tools_changed.description: Whether the tool schema hash differs from the previous observed day; null when either is unknown.

retry_reached_level.description: Result of the same-day retry, when one was made.

missing_days.description: Days since the first observation (within the last 30 days, before today UTC) with no observation row, and the recorded reason: not_in_registry, no_remote, remote_not_probeable, not_active, or no_observation.

tools.description: Tool names returned by tools/list in the latest successful observation (from scanner 0.4.0, 2026-10-20). Names only; descriptions are not stored. Names outside [A-Za-z0-9_.-/]{1,64} are omitted.

partial.description: true when tools/list announced more pages; only the first page is recorded.

set_first_observed_at.description: When Lowdown first observed this exact set of tool names for the target.

declared_vs_observed.description: Declared and observed values side by side. No judgment is made.

method.description: How the observations were made and what they do not show.

scanner_candidates.description: Returned instead of `scanner` when a short name matches several scanned servers.

protocol_requests.description: initialize, tools/list, ping and other non-tool requests (not in success_rate).

rejected_requests.description: Requests rejected as malformed, unknown tool, or invalid arguments (not in success_rate).

success_rate.description: Share of successes among rated interactions: organic tool calls and agent reports. Protocol requests, rejected requests, and seeded or synthetic records are excluded. null when there are none.

confidence.description: Based on rated_interactions (none = 0, low < 10, medium < 100, high >= 100).

source.description: Attribution that should travel with any republished record. The lookup URL is present only for a verified Registry name; request text is never included.

post.summary: Record an interaction with an agent, tool, or service

source.description: organic (default) for real use; synthetic for tests, including intentional failure tests.

request_kind.description: Default reported. The proxy sends tool_call / protocol.

error_layer.description: request = the request itself was rejected (malformed, unknown tool, invalid arguments); not counted in success_rate.

429.description: More than 120 records per minute for this node_id (or actor).
